response.sql:
WITH combination_counts AS (
  SELECT
    o.recordvault AS order_reference,
    o.orderflow AS order_status,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM riskandmargin AS rm
  JOIN orders AS o
    ON rm.ordervault = o.recordvault
  GROUP BY o.recordvault, o.orderflow
), shares AS (
  SELECT
    order_reference,
    order_status,
    record_count,
    record_count::numeric / SUM(record_count) OVER (PARTITION BY order_status) AS share
  FROM combination_counts
), compared AS (
  SELECT
    order_reference,
    order_status,
    record_count,
    share,
    share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY order_status) AS share_minus_status_average
  FROM shares
)
SELECT order_reference, order_status, record_count, share, share_minus_status_average
FROM compared
WHERE share_minus_status_average > 0
ORDER BY share_minus_status_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The share for each order reference and status is its count divided by the total risk/margin record count for that status; the status average is the unweighted mean of those combination shares.
